title: Bolander & Co is helping Vantel shape the future of how brokers place complex risks - Vantel
summary: Vantel turns complex insurance documents into structured intelligence, helping brokerages understand coverage, reduce risk, and make better decisions faster.
body_markdown:
Founded in 1973, Bolander & Co is one of Sweden’s leading insurance brokers in property insurance, with deep expertise in real estate and property-related risks. The firm also has specialist teams within industry, life science and the public sector, complemented by dedicated claims consulting services. Bolander & Co is a member of WING - Worldwide Insurance Network Group.


Bolander's brokers are using Vantel to review quotes and wordings, and the two teams work closely on improving and expanding the platform's capabilities.


As Linnéa Herfindal, Insurance Lawyer at Bolander & Co, puts it:


> Tender documents and wording comparisons take a large share of our time every renewal season, and AI is changing how that work is done. Working with Vantel from an early stage means that we get to shape the change, rather than wait for it.


Thank you to Linnéa and the whole Bolander team. We are proud to be building this together.
